nodes.claim: The zero set of $f$ equals the inverse image of the closed singleton $\{0\}\subseteq\mathbb R$.
nodes.text:
\begin{proof}

    $Z(f)=f^{-1}(\{0\})$, which is the inverse image of a closed set.

nodes.claim: By continuity of $f$, the inverse image $Z(f)=f^{-1}(\{0\})$ of the closed set $\{0\}$ is closed in $X$.
